q: Users report that a feature “got worse last week”, but nobody can show an example. Which layer should you work on first?
options: Models: switch to a stronger model
Evals and observability: collect traces and do error analysis
explain: Without traces and evals you cannot locate the problem, let alone fix it. Start with [error analysis](#error-analysis).

q: Why does decoding speed track GPU memory bandwidth more than raw FLOPs?
options: Because tokens are stored in GPU memory
Because each new token reads every weight from memory once, with little arithmetic per byte
Because the KV cache is compressed
explain: Generating one token does about two FLOPs per parameter but must stream all parameters from memory, so bandwidth is the limit. See [inference fundamentals](#inference-fundamentals).

q: Security and LLMOps are drawn as columns rather than layers because…
options: they only apply to the model layer
they cut across every layer, from tools to product
they are handled by the cloud provider
explain: An agent with tools inherits the attack surface of every layer, and operations spans all of them too.
